Responsive switches and reliable performance built to keep up with every strategy and split-second decision.
Precision tracking and customizable controls give you the confidence to make your next move count.
Carry your Legion setup safely with storage and protection built for gaming on the move.
NVIDIA® GEFORCE RTX™ 50 SERIES LAPTOP GPU

A suite of neural rendering technologies that uses AI to boost FPS, reduce latency, and improve image quality. DLSS 4, brings new Multi Frame Generation and Super Resolution, powered by GeForce RTX™ 50 Series Laptop GPUs and fifth-gen Tensor Cores.
Cinematic quality visuals at unprecedented speed, enabled by 4th gen RT Cores and breakthrough neural rendering technologies accelerated with 5th gen Tensor cores.
Reflex 2 with Frame Warp gives you the ultimate responsiveness, enhancing target acquisition, reaction time, and aim precision.
Try Xbox Game Pass With Your Lenovo Legion/LOQ Device
Play Starfield, Palworld and 200+ more games on Lenovo Legion/LOQ devices with Xbox Game Pass. *
*Game catalogue varies over time, by region and device. Terms and conditions apply. See xbox.com/subscriptionterms for full details

Lenovo AI Engine+ gives aspiring esports gamers the edge to win with real-time Scenario Detection for optimized FPS and smarter resource allocation. Smart FPS ensures buttery-smooth performance and fine-tunes CPU/GPU for top tier competitive play. Drive your gameplay with AI-powered precision and dominate every moment on the battlefield.
Provides clarity and precision for fast-paced, competitive gaming with unmatched responsiveness.
Enables instant reactions and adjusts FPS for smooth, high-performance gameplay at <.5ms response times.
Spot hidden opponents in dark areas for a tactical advantage in any game with improved contrast ratio 1,000,000:1 vs 1200:1 of traditional IPS panels.
Prevents screen burn-in during long gaming sessions, ensuring lasting performance for those competitive marathons. Enable further protections for your display in Legion Space.
Stay Cool, Play Silent, Take Control. Climb the Ranks.

Stay cool and quiet with turbo-charged fans and 3D copper heat pipes that redirect airflow. Use FN+Q to switch between Quiet, Balance, Performance, and Extreme modes, tuned by Lenovo AI Engine+ for stable, high FPS. Precision fans, heat pipes, and Acoustic AI Sound Sync reduce noise and optimize performance, keeping you focused for peak gaming.
Effortlessly switch between Quiet, Balance, Performance or Extreme mode with this convenient key-combination to game instantly shift from work to high-adrenaline gameplay.
Expanding from Balance Mode to Performance Mode, the Lenovo AI Engine+ tunes your fan systems for an improved fan curve for stable high FPS.
3D-printed and engineered with laser-precision, these fans effectively grab cool air and direct it over key components for competitive gaming sessions.
Impressively robust copper heat pipes and aluminum heat sinks on key components keeps your system temps at record lows.

The Legion Pro 5i keeps cool with massive rear vents, ensuring optimal airflow and comfort during gaming. Its Eclipse Black finish, AI-synced RGB keyboard, and durable build create an immersive, sustainable design. Packed with Ethernet, HDMI 2.1, and an eShutter webcam, it’s a powerful desktop replacement built for competitive play.
Large rear vents optimize airflow, keeping your system cool and ensuring peak performance during intense gaming.
Heat is directed out the back, keeping your keyboard, mouse, and hands cool for extended comfort.

Nahimic by SteelSeries Audio for Games. AI-Powered Immersive 3D Audio.

Nahimic by SteelSeries leverages AI technology to deliver immersive 3D audio and tailored sound profiles, transforming your gaming experience. Nahimic’s AI Smart Profile adjusts audio settings automatically, ensuring you’re always in the game’s sweet spot.
Precision Keystrokes for the Competitive Edge

Master precision with the Legion TrueStrike keyboard—designed for competitive gamers needing instant responsiveness to match fast reaction times. This full-sized keyboard, with dedicated arrow keys, a number pad, and a Mylar touchpad, is perfect for on the go. Customize 24-zone RGB lighting through Lenovo Spectrum and sync it via Legion Space for the ideal setup.

Take your battlestation anywhere with the Legion Pro 5i, featuring up to 245W charging support, 80Whr battery capacity, and Super Rapid Charge technology to keep you in the action. Built for fast docked performance anywhere in the world, it also supports 140W USB-C* charging for everyday power needs. Powered by WiFi 7 (320MHz) for low-latency wireless gaming.
Customize system settings, get exclusive deals and more in easy-to-use software suite.*

Legion Space adds evolving AI features for enhanced creativity and gaming. Enjoy out-of-the-box compatibility with driver updates, ensuring reliable performance for years to come.

That's why we pursue industry leading labels and certifications that demonstrate our commitment to sustainability in product design. Together, we can build a smarter future for all.
